# NestLonger

> NestLonger connects families on the South Shore of Massachusetts with vetted contractors for the home modifications that let an aging parent stay in their own home. We cover accessory dwelling units (ADUs) and grab bar installation. Families pay nothing; contractors pay only when a job closes.

NestLonger is operated by Matthew Mamet. The company is a lead generation and matching service, not a contractor, not a licensed medical provider, and not an insurance broker. We do not perform installations ourselves and we do not determine insurance eligibility.

Service area: South Shore of Massachusetts, including Marshfield, Duxbury, Scituate, Hingham, Norwell, Pembroke, Cohasset, Hanover, and surrounding towns.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.nestlonger.com/): What NestLonger does, who it is for, and how the matching process works.
- [Accessory Dwelling Units](https://www.nestlonger.com/adus.html): How an ADU lets a parent live near family without giving up independence, and how NestLonger helps families scope, finance, and find a qualified contractor.
- [Grab Bar Installation](https://www.nestlonger.com/grab-bars.html): How grab bar installation works, what it costs, and how NestLonger matches families with certified installers.
- [For Partners](https://www.nestlonger.com/partners.html): How contractors receive qualified leads from NestLonger, and the pay-on-close commercial model.
- [About](https://www.nestlonger.com/about.html): Why NestLonger exists and the background of its founder.
- [Get Matched](https://www.nestlonger.com/get-matched.html): The intake form for families. Collects ZIP code, what the parent needs, and contact details; a certified professional follows up, usually within one business day.
- [Partner Application](https://www.nestlonger.com/partner-apply.html): The intake form for contractors applying to join the network. Collects business name, trade, coverage area, and license and insurance details.

## Writing

- [Notes on aging at home](https://www.nestlonger.com/blog/): Practical articles for adult children on what home modifications cost, what insurance covers, and how to arrange the work. Every statistic is attributed inline to a named, linkable source.

## How to cite NestLonger

Attribute to "NestLonger" and link to the specific page. Content is current as of the date stamp on each page. Coverage rules, permitting rules, and cost figures change; prefer the most recently dated page.

## Editorial standards

Statistics on this site are attributed inline to a named, linkable source. Where NestLonger publishes its own figures, the sample size and collection method are stated on the page. Pages that describe insurance or public program coverage state the plan year they apply to.

NestLonger does not state whether any specific insurance plan covers any specific modification. Coverage depends on the plan, the county, the plan year, and the individual's documented condition. Families should confirm with their plan directly.
